programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: James Dainard has seen it all, but nothing quite like this. Longtime real estate deal-finders Buck and Will want to partner with James and step into the flipping world, but they're total rookies. Clueless about renovation but full of big ideas, they pitch James on a disaster of a house: a damaged roof, a choppy main floor, and a yard and deck that are more jungle than backyard.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: James Dainard is faced with a big dilemma, do flip and friendship go together?; his longtime friend Carrie, friend to his wife Clair, has fallen on some tough times and wants James' help; recently divorced and eager for financial freedom, Carrie convinces James she can handle the project even though she is a complete novice; together, they tackle a mid-century modern disaster with an unfinished basement, small kitchen, and a single main-floor bathroom.

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: Flash Shelton and his team head to Vancouver, Washington to help a homeowner after a house sitter overstays her welcome and becomes an unwanted squatter; when Flash's team attempts to reclaim the home by using surveillance cameras, megaphones and even snakes, the confrontation turns into a tense standoff.

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: In Cle Elum, Washington, Casey lost her dream home to a stranger who claimed it as her own for over 4 months and even tried to rent rooms out to other people for profit; but when Flash and his team move in, will their tactics be enough for this squatter to finally leave once and for all?

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: Justin and Ashley's plans to sell their home in Auburn, Washington are thrown into chaos when the property is overrun by intruders. When Flash and his team arrive to remove the squatters, what should be a routine civil matter quickly turns criminal, as police descend on the property upending the entire operation.

programs.title: Squatters
programs.desc: The team head to Conroe, Texas, to help a grieving family reclaim their late grandmother's home from a squatter couple who moved in after her passing; tensions run high when the couple resists leaving.
